release_notes:
### Added
- **Onboard Display Controls & Hardware Brightness**:
  - Added display brightness slider (10% to 100%) utilizing hardware LEDC PWM on GPIO 38.
  - Added "Cycle Screen" button in the web interface that mimics the physical GPIO 0 button press.
  - Added direct screen jump buttons for Page 1 (Live Status), Page 2 (Network Info), and Page 3 (Bluetooth Status).
  - Saved screen backlight and brightness preferences in non-volatile flash configuration.
- **LilyGO T-Dongle-S3 Onboard RGB LED (APA102) & Enhanced LED Modes**:
  - Direct hardware driver for the onboard APA102 DotStar RGB LED (GPIO 39 Clock, GPIO 40 Data).
  - Updated Jiggler LED Mode options on T-Dongle-S3:
    - **`On (Screen Backlight)`**: Lights the LCD screen backlight during active jiggles for the configured duration.
    - **`Blink Colour`**: Pulses the onboard APA102 RGB LED in a user-selected color at the chosen blink frequency.
    - **`Solid Colour`**: Illuminates the onboard APA102 RGB LED solid in a user-selected color.
  - Integrated color picker for selecting custom hex colors (`#RRGGBB`).
  - Preserved backward compatibility for ESP32-S2 mono LED on GPIO 17 (`Solid` / `Blink`).
- **Stealth Access Point (Office Mode)**:
  - Removed hardcoded `"Jiggler-"` identifier from default setup SoftAP broadcasts.
  - Added configurable SoftAP SSID with stealth presets (`Office-Direct-Setup`, `HP-Print-42-DeskJet`, `Direct-Roku-812`, `Dell-Universal-Link`, `ESP-Device-Setup`) and custom name input.
  - Added optional WPA2 password protection and "Hidden Network" beacon suppression (`apHidden`).

### Fixed
- **Screen Backlight Control**:
  - Fixed `/api/display` endpoint to correctly parse JSON POST bodies and update backlight status.
  - Disabled both the LCD ST7735 controller (`enableDisplay(false)`) and active-low LEDC PWM channel (duty 255) to fully power down the screen.
  - Allowed short-pressing physical button 0 to re-wake the screen when turned off.
- **Keyboard Tab Target Dropdown Layout**:
  - Resolved UI overflow where the "Send Keystrokes To" dropdown extended past the "Keyboard Target" box on long slot names and Bluetooth identities.
  - Applied flexbox boundary constraints (`min-width: 0`, `max-width: 100%`, and `text-overflow: ellipsis`) and streamlined target label formatting.

### Fixed
- **Resolved Boot Loop Caused by Native USB Pin Reconfiguration**:
  - Reverted `pinMode()` calls on GPIO 19 (`D-`) and GPIO 20 (`D+`). On the ESP32-S3, manipulating these pins as general-purpose GPIOs disrupts the internal USB OTG PHY, causing fatal hardware exceptions and continuous boot loops on startup.
  - Reverted direct register writes to `RTC_CNTL_BROWN_OUT_REG`.
  - Restored the rock-solid, proven v2.6.1 boot sequence and USB HID initialization.
